MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 3, 2025

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR OLSON at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Olson, Nicklas, Medawar, Romanelli, Schachter, Yoo

  Commissioners Absent:  Repp-Loadsman

  City Staff Present:  Jeannie Naughton, Community Development Director
  Whitney Berry, Senior Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, JANUARY 6, 2025

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR made a motion seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF JANUARY 6,
  2025.

There being no objection, CHAIR OLSON so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READY BY TITLE ONLY.

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6A

There being no objection, CHAIR OLSON so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION No.: PA-250009; ADDRESS: 6 Branding Iron Lane, Rolling
  Hills Estates, CA 90274; APPLICANT: Gregory W. George, Studio GWG; DESCRIPTION:
  A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-250010) for a 1,024-
  square-foot pergola on an existing attached deck, a Grading application (G-250011) for
  the construction of retaining walls with a maximum depth of fill of five feet and a Minor
  Deviation (MD-250012) to construct a pergola that encroaches into the front yard not
  further than the forwardmost building line.

Senior Planner Berry provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
Application No. PA-250009. In 2019, a proposal for a remodel and addition project was approved;
however, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the project was put on hold. In 2023, the project was
resubmitted, approved by Planning and building permits were issued and is currently under
construction. Part of the project is a horse keeping area in the rear yard, which includes a stable

 PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
 MINUTES, FEBRUARY 3, 2025
  1
 and large arena. A site plan was shown with the existing structures which include a 749 SF ADU.
Last year, a Minor Deviation and Variance were approved for improvements to the front yard. The
proposed project includes a pergola structure around existing decks, a new pool and spa, a pool
pavilion, and subterranean pool pavilion area, decking around the pool, a new seating area, new
driveway, and landscaping throughout the site. The Grading Application is for fill greater than 3
FT in height to support these improvements and the new retaining wall.

Senior Planner Berry stated that the project meets the criteria for Neighborhood Compatibility and
approval of a Grading Application. Additionally, there is a request for a Minor Deviation due to a
minor change to the previous approval in the front yard, to accommodate the construction of the
pergola.

Senior Planner Berry stated that staff recommend that the Planning Commission approve
Planning Application No. PA-250009 with the conditions outlined in the staff report.

CHAIR OLSON requested clarification on removal of materials from the site. He stated that the
staff report shows that 392 cubic yards of material will be taken off the property and the Grading
Application states that there will be no removal of earth materials. Senior Planner Berry stated
that there is a distinction between the material that will be removed for the foundation of the pool
and pool pavilion, which is not part of the Grading Application. The 392 cubic yards of material
will be removed for the pool and pool pavilion.

CHAIR OLSON asked about the truck routes for the removal of materials. Senior Planner Berry
stated that the Building and Safety team will advise on truck routes and timing.

Greg George, Applicant, stated that this is a horse property with one of the best barns in the city.
He stated that the intent is to provide architectural consistency with the pergola and pool pavilion.
Mr. Greg stated that some of the soil that will be used for fill will be from the excavated earth
material for the pool and pool pavilion. The grading will also keep drainage out of the arena. Mr.
George stated that the area will be a level grass terrace that will overlook the arena.

COMMISSIONER NICKLAS made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to:

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-250009 WITH THE CONDITIONS
  OUTLINED IN THE STAFF REPORT.

AYES: OLSON, NICKLAS, MEDAWAR, ROMANELLI, SCHACHTER, YOO
NOES:
ABSENT: REPP-LOADSMAN
ABSTAIN:

Director Naughton stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning Application No.
PA-250009, a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination for a 1,024-square-foot pergola on an
existing attached deck, a Grading application for the construction of retaining walls with a
maximum depth of fill of five feet and a Minor Deviation to construct a pergola that encroaches
into the front yard not further than the forwardmost building line. There is a 20-day appeal period
by which any member of the public may appeal this decision or the Council by its own motion.

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION No.: PA-240509; ADDRESS:26140 Marina Drive, Rolling Hills
  Estates, CA 90274; APPLICANT: Megan Campbell, Campbell Architects; DESCRIPTION:
  A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-240510) for first and
  second story additions to an existing one-story, single-family residence, a Variance (V-
  240511) for an addition that will be built within a required front yard and projects beyond
  the existing forwardmost building line and a Grading Permit (G-240512) for the excavation
  and fill of earth materials greater than three feet in vertical height at its deepest point.

Senior Planner Berry stated that the applicant has requested that this item be continued in order
to redesign the project to eliminate a second story addition and prepare the materials; a revised
silhouette will be constructed. This will provide time for the Marloma HOA and the neighboring
residents to review the revised project. In addition, it will allow time for staff to review the project
and provide findings for Planning Commission consideration. Staff will re-notice this project to a
500’ radius and publish the notice in the newspaper.

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  CONTINUE ITEM NO. PA-240509.

9.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR inquired about the status of the medical office building at 758 Bart
Earle Way. Director Naughton stated that staff continue to work with the applicant to address the
conditions of the back lot. An update will be provided soon.

COMMISSIONER NICKLAS inquired about any discussions related to the fires and how it might
relate to planning in the city. Director Naughton stated that there is an action memo available from
the January 14 City Council meeting; Assistant Fire Chief Kane provided an update on the Eaton
and Pacific Palisades fires and provided information on fire safety in Palos Verdes Peninsula.
Currently, the City is in the process of signing and executing an MOU with the other PV Peninsula
cities to prepare a joint Hazard Mitigation Plan which will address items related to public safety
including fires and evacuation.

COMMISSIONER NICKLAS asked about the reservoir. Director Naughton stated that she will
come back to the commission with more information. What is known is that MWD was making
repairs to the reservoir, but not sure of the current status. COMMISSIONER OLSON asked if an
update could be provided from MWD since it is believed to be empty.

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

Director Naughton reminded the Planning Commissioners to reach out to staff if they are
interested in attending the Planning Commissioners Academy in Santa Rosa in March.

interested in attending the Planning Commissioners Academy in Santa Rosa in March.

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, JANUARY 14, 2025

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM 11A.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR OLSON adjourned the meeting at 7:26 p.m. to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting on Monday, March 3, 2025 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos
Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates.

Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst  Larry Olson, Chair
